description: Figure 2, titled "Performance with different chunking sizes," is a line plot illustrating the relationship between chunk size (in tokens) and model performance, measured as a score on the y-axis. The x-axis, labeled "Chunk Size (tokens)," uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1500, with major tick marks at intervals of 200. The y-axis, labeled "Performance," also uses a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 35, with major tick marks at intervals of 5. The plot contains a single solid blue line with circular markers. This line begins at a performance score of approximately 30.5 when the chunk size is 200 tokens. As the chunk size increases to 400 tokens, the performance rises slightly to about 31.0. It then peaks at a chunk size of 600 tokens with a score of approximately 31.5. Beyond this point, performance declines steadily, reaching approximately 28.0 at 1000 tokens and falling further to about 25.0 at 1500 tokens.
